# Release notes

Every released version, newest first. The **Added** sections are the ones to read before an upgrade: a new ERROR-severity rule fails a build that passed on the previous version. Each version page is generated from [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/RohithV16/aem-code-analyser/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md), which is the single source for these notes.

| Version | Released | Contents |

| **[1.0.9](1.0.9/)** | 2026-11-16 | Changed · Build |
| **[1.0.8](1.0.8/)** | 2026-11-16 | Changed · Added · Fixed |
| **[1.0.7](1.0.7/)** | 2026-11-16 | Added |
| **[1.0.6](1.0.6/)** | 2026-11-16 | Fixed |

| **[1.0.0](1.0.0/)** | 2026-11-15 | Fixed (after 1.0.0 snapshot) · Fixed (genericity / false positives) · Added (2) · Added (enhancement wave) · Changed |

Prefer to verify a download before running it? The [installer](https://github.com/RohithV16/aem-code-analyser/blob/main/install.sh) checks the jar against the release's `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
